text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Geary Works Planning Study, concluded in 2021, was a comprehensive interdivisional study and community vision for Geary Avenue, and included a Mobility and Public Realm Strategy and provided ten (10) strategic directions for the right-of-way and streetscape on Geary Avenue. This report contains a status update and outline of the pathway for implementation of all ten strategic directions, in response to a request from Toronto and East York Community Council.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the Item until the July 8, 2025 meeting of the Toronto and East York Community Council.
